# Test Report — TOEIC Dictionary v2.95.9

**Scope:** v2.95.8 baseline plus Robot Buddy progressive replies and locally composed context-aware response phrasing.

## Release changes verified

- Robot Buddy displays a preparation indicator, then progressively reveals the reply with a blinking caret. Text is inserted with `textContent`; streamed text is not injected as HTML.
- The renderer uses grapheme segmentation when `Intl.Segmenter` is available, falls back safely, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- A new user turn finishes any in-flight response before adding the next turn. Reply actions are appended only after the response completes.
- Supported feature, FAQ, contextual-help, encouragement and clarification responses are composed from local phrase groups, existing library content, rule-based intent and the active in-memory app/item context.
- Unknown prompts request clarification instead of fabricating an answer.
- No generative model, external API, backend, WebSocket or external learner-data transmission was added. Robot Buddy does not read IndexedDB/localStorage directly.
- Learning Insights remains opt-in and read-only through the app-provided in-memory snapshot. Existing dashboard, navigation, content, TTS and learner storage contracts remain in place.

## Automated verification

| Check | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| JavaScript regression suites | **35/35 PASS** | Includes the new `robot-buddy-streaming.mjs` suite and existing Buddy/dashboard/layout suites |
| JavaScript syntax | **PASS** | Every `assets/js/*.js` file and `sw.js` passed `node --check` |
| Python syntax compilation | **PASS** | `python -m compileall -q tools` |
| Python test modules | **53/54 completed individually** | `test_validator.py` full module exceeded the 300-second execution window; 23 of 38 cases had reported `ok` before timeout. Two relevant cases (`test_new_defect_not_hidden_by_equal_count`, `test_manifest_total_words_wrong`) passed when run individually. Do not interpret this as 54/54 complete. |
| CI coverage | **3/3 PASS** | Confirms all JS suites and Python modules are included in workflow and editorial review has an explicit CI step |
| Repository integrity test | **1/1 PASS** | Dedicated Python test |
| Responsive-layout tests | **7/7 PASS** | Includes Robot Buddy input/dashboard layout checks |
| Version synchronization | **PASS** | App, Service Worker, HTML and current docs declare 2.95.9 |
| Repository integrity audit | **PASS** | 364 local references/data files inspected; 0 errors, 0 optional warnings |
| Vocabulary validation | **PASS** | 1,141 records; 0 errors, 0 new warnings; 213 additive IDs relative to the legacy baseline, 0 removed |
| Learning-content validation | **PASS** | Listening 121 units/239 questions; Reading 65/263; Grammar 50/137; separate Part 5 practice 80; 0 errors, 0 warnings |

### Test limitation

The full `test_validator.py` suite did not finish within its execution window. Although the first 23 of 38 cases returned `ok` and two relevant cases later passed in isolation, the remaining full-suite coverage is **not claimed as passing**. The remote GitHub Actions workflow must run after the source is uploaded to verify the full CI gate in its intended environment.

## Not verified in this workspace

- Remote GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages deployment/cache update.
- Browser-level visual acceptance of the streaming effect and its timing.
- Actual offline PWA installation/reconnect behavior after deployment.
- Screen-reader behavior and physical-device performance on Windows, iOS/iPadOS and Android.
- Audible TTS voice quality and real acoustic pause timing on each device.

## Data and release safety

- No IndexedDB schema change, localStorage key reset, learner-record migration or progress reset was made.
- Vocabulary/question content, answer keys, stable IDs and Mock eligibility were not changed by this Robot Buddy release.
- Generated `__pycache__`, `.pyc` and `.pyo` artifacts are excluded from the release ZIP.
- Local checks do not prove a successful GitHub push or deployment. Neither was performed by this test run.

## Conclusion

The v2.95.9 source passes the complete JavaScript regression suite, version/data/repository audits and the listed focused Python checks. One Python validator module remains partially unverified due to an execution timeout, and all deployment/browser/device acceptance gates remain open. Use `USER_ACCEPTANCE_TEST_v2.95.9.md` for post-upload acceptance.

## Quality / verification status

- Content counts do not equal completed learning outcomes.
- Outcome framework: 33/33 criteria defined; 6/33 have an evidence-collection path. Neither count measures learner mastery.
- TOEIC objective tracker: aggregates latest answer per stable unique question; minimum 10 unique items and 80% accuracy. A passing label is a practice threshold only, not CEFR/ETS certification or proof of every outcome.
- Objective evidence is connected for Grammar, Listening Parts 1–4, Reading Parts 5–7 and separate Part 5 practice. Reserve Listening items are excluded until editorial review; Reading Part 7 remains second-review-gated; the separate 80-item Part 5 practice pool is review-pending and cannot earn a threshold status.
- Listening Part 1 currently has 8 eligible unique questions (one additional mapped item is reserve-pending), below the 10-item minimum; at least 2 more unique, reviewed questions are needed before it can reach the practice threshold.
- Foundation outcome evidence now records recognition, a learner-authored sentence with three self-report explanation/production ratings, and delayed recall. Self-report is not auto-graded; delayed recall is scheduled 1/3 days and is not a retention guarantee.
- Foundation Listening stores attempts under a separate localStorage key; its bank coverage does not imply the learner has completed the questions or met the local practice threshold.
- Supplementary A2 Listening has 13 six-turn dialogues (75–100 words each), 39 questions across detail, purpose/context and inference/next-action, with exact source-evidence snippets; all remain pending independent review and use browser TTS.
- v2.92.0 batch 024 adds 8 Grammar lessons / 24 exercises, 6 TOEIC Listening units / 18 questions, and 6 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 27 questions. All 12 new Listening/Reading resources remain reserve-pending-independent-review and excluded from Mock eligibility. v2.93.0 batch 025 adds 9 Grammar lessons / 27 exercises, 8 TOEIC Listening units / 20 questions, 8 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 36 questions and 4 vocabulary headwords; new Listening/Reading items remain pending independent review and Mock-excluded.
- Foundation A–Z records TTS play-button actions in `toeic:alphabet-sound-progress:v1`; no pronunciation analysis or mastery inference is performed.
- Part 5 practice: pending independent review; do not count as Mock-eligible.
- Independent-review handoff queue: 137 Listening questions across 65 units + 63 Reading Part 7 questions across 14 resources + 80 separate Part 5 questions = 280 item-level decisions. Queue presence means traceable reviewer handoff only, not approval or Mock eligibility.
- Listening pending-review pool and Mock-eligible counts must be tracked separately from raw inventory.
- Placement is a short sample, not official CEFR/ETS certification.
- TOEIC score readiness is a local evidence tracker based on three completed 200-question Full Mocks; it shows L/R practice-accuracy trends only and does not convert raw accuracy into ETS scaled scores or claim 500+/850+ readiness.
- Remote CI, GitHub Pages deployment and physical-device QA are not inferred from local checks.

## Reporting rule

A percentage is shown only when a defensible target or denominator exists. Otherwise the report says “Chưa đo được” and records the current inventory without inventing a target.

# TOEIC Distractor & Answer-Uniqueness Audit — v2.95.18

## Scope and method
- Scope covers **240 questions** across Mock-eligible Listening Part 3 (39), Listening Part 4 (30) and the full Reading Part 7 inventory (171). The Part 7 inventory contains the 108-question pre-Batch-024 base, 27 v2.92.0 questions and 36 v2.93.0 questions. New reserve items remain pending independent review; structural checks do not confer semantic approval.
- The historical Part 7 base remains separately tracked from the v2.92.0 and v2.93.0 reserve additions. Batch 025 includes traceable source quotes, answer-key checks, four-distinct-choice checks, stable choice IDs and a balanced A/B/C/D answer-position distribution (9 each). Semantic distractor uniqueness for new items still requires second-person review.
- Structural checks in this script verify four distinct options and a valid key. They do **not** certify semantic uniqueness by algorithm and are not a substitute for a second human reviewer or psychometric analysis.

|---|---|---:|---:|

## Twelve distractor revisions applied
| Library / set / question | Editorial change |
|---|---|
| Listening · `part3-hotel-reservation` · Q1 | Replaced unrelated hotel-service alternatives with other plausible booking requests. |
| Listening · `part3-client-presentation` · Q3 | Aligned all alternatives with realistic presentation-preparation actions. |
| Listening · `part4-training-registration` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives as plausible employee groups. |

| Reading · `customer-refund-email` · Q1 | Replaced the unrelated hotel refund with realistic keyboard/order-resolution requests. |
| Reading · `supplier-invoice-followup` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives with common invoice/payment verification issues. |
| Reading · `double-passage-order` · Q1 | Replaced off-topic alternatives with plausible causes of a shipment delay. |

## Answer-position distribution — balanced with stable choice identity
| Part | A | B | C | D | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Part 3 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 9 | 39 |
| Part 4 | 8 | 8 | 7 | 7 | 30 |
| Part 7 | 43 | 43 | 43 | 42 | 171 |

**Rebalancing method:** 27 question groups had only the keyed option exchanged with a distractor position: 8 in Part 3, 5 in Part 4 and 14 in Part 7. The answer text, source evidence, explanation, question IDs and question order were retained. Each changed question carries `previousChoices` and `previousChoiceIds` from v2.16.0; the matching `choiceIds` moved with the option. At startup, progress containing a v2.16 `choiceId` is relocated to its new index; older records without an ID are mapped through the v2.16 snapshot. The prior index is preserved in `previousChoiceIndex`. No random shuffle was used.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Historical reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. For the new v2.92.0 and v2.93.0 Part 7 groups, close dates/times, locations, delivery steps and document-purpose alternatives were authored to be plausible, but an independent reviewer must confirm that exactly one option is defensible.
- Listening reserve total: 137 questions across 65 units. This script structurally checks Part 3/4 reserve blocks; Part 2 response-fit is tracked separately. Structural checks never approve a reserve for Mock.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 uses source-tracked licensed Pexels and AI-generated photographs with a JPG-only runtime contract; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

# Test Report — TOEIC Dictionary v2.95.14 candidate

## Scope

- Candidate: **v2.95.14**, local source only.
- Baseline: v2.95.13 at commit `a04a4d97472cb856c2459aab19d2a18090204e40`.
- Change scope: ten related-term glossary additions, provenance and regression coverage, CI path-filter hardening, release metadata/docs.
- This report does not claim remote GitHub Actions, Pages deployment, browser/device acceptance or independent lexical approval.

## Change summary

- Related-term glossary increased from 373 to 383 entries.
- Added Vietnamese glosses and concise English definitions for ten existing link terms: `requirement`, `pay`, `ignore`, `withhold`, `retain`, `earnings`, `duty`, `distribute`, `discourage`, `decline`.
- Added provenance batch 021 and an absent-only patch guarded by the v2.95.13 base-file SHA-256.
- CI now executes the new focused regression and triggers when `patches-related-terms/**` changes on push or pull request.
- Canonical vocabulary remains 1,141 headwords; stable IDs, words, topics, synonym/antonym links and learner data are unchanged.

## Automated verification

### Focused Python unit tests

**5 modules / 43 test cases passed**, each command exited 0.

| Module | Cases | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| `test_related_glossary_batch_021.py` | 6 | PASS |
| `test_patch_related_terms.py` | 11 | PASS |
| `test_vocabulary_detail_examples.py` | 19 | PASS |
| `test_ci_coverage.py` | 3 | PASS |
| `test_project_progress.py` | 4 | PASS |
| **Total** | **43** | **PASS** |

The new glossary test verifies source metadata, correspondence between patch and ledger, existing synonym/antonym use, a minimum frequency of three references per term, no duplicate glossary keys and CI path-filter coverage.

### JavaScript regression

**38/38 `.mjs` test files passed** when run individually. The release-integrity test also passed after adding an explicit v2.95.14 manifest assertion and batch-021 coverage.

### Data, content and integrity checks

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `python tools/validate-data.py` | 1,141 records; ID additions 0 / missing 0; 0 errors / 0 warnings |
| `python tools/validate-learning-content.py` | Listening 121 units / 239 questions; Reading 65 / 263; Grammar 50 / 137; Part 5 practice 80; 0 errors / 0 warnings |
| `python tools/audit-repository-integrity.py` | 382 local references/data files; 0 errors / 0 optional warnings |
| `python tools/sync-version.py --check` | All release markers synchronized to v2.95.14 |
| `node tools/tests/vocabulary-release-integrity.mjs` | PASS; 1,141 unique records, 383 glossary entries and batch 021 verified |
| `node --check assets/js/app.js`; `node --check sw.js` | PASS |
| `python -m py_compile tools/tests/test_related_glossary_batch_021.py` | PASS |

### Patch safety and replay

The v2.95.14 patch was rollback-tested to restore the baseline glossary file hash, then dry-run and applied. Dry-run and apply both passed. The patch contains ten `expect.absent=true` operations, rejects overwrites, validates Cambridge hostname/path constraints and checks the exact base-file SHA-256. The patcher regression is 11/11 PASS.

## Editorial coverage metrics

- Current glossary count: 383.
- 804 distinct terms occur in canonical synonym/antonym fields; 372 have a matching glossary record and 432 remain unglossed.
- 477 of 1,037 synonym/antonym link occurrences remain unglossed. The ten additions resolve 33 previously unglossed occurrences.
- `validate-data.py` separately reports `syn/ant chưa có nghĩa=323/804`; this legacy informational metric uses a different counting rule and must not be conflated with the exact-term join above.
- Other editorial indicators remain: 93 missing US IPA entries, four duplicate-definition pairs and nine word/sense CEFR differences. They were not modified in this release.

## Not run / not verified

- The entire Python test inventory (57 modules) and one aggregate `unittest discover` run were not completed; only the five focused modules listed above were run for this candidate.
- The GitHub Actions workflow itself was not run remotely. Local checks of the workflow definition do not equal a remote CI result.
- GitHub Pages deployment, `/Toeic/` path, PWA installation, offline/reconnect, two-tab update, actual desktop/mobile rendering, iPhone/Android TTS and device audio remain unverified.
- All **21** owner-run checks in `reports/MANUAL_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md` remain **Chưa kiểm**.
- New glossary entries remain provisional pending independent lexical review.
- No GitHub push or deployment was performed.

## Evidence files

- `reports/COMMAND_LOG_INDEX_v2.95.14.md`
- `reports/CHANGE_MANIFEST_v2.95.14.md`
- `reports/VOCABULARY_GLOSSARY_EXPANSION_v2.95.14.md`
- `reports/MANUAL_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md`
- Test logs distributed with `TOEIC_v2.95.14_Test_Logs.zip`.

## Scope and method
- Scope covers **240 questions** across Mock-eligible Listening Part 3 (39), Listening Part 4 (30) and the full Reading Part 7 inventory (171). The Part 7 inventory contains the 108-question pre-Batch-024 base, 27 v2.92.0 questions and 36 v2.93.0 questions. New reserve items remain pending independent review; structural checks do not confer semantic approval.
- The historical Part 7 base remains separately tracked from the v2.92.0 and v2.93.0 reserve additions. Batch 025 includes traceable source quotes, answer-key checks, four-distinct-choice checks, stable choice IDs and a balanced A/B/C/D answer-position distribution (9 each). Semantic distractor uniqueness for new items still requires second-person review.
- Structural checks in this script verify four distinct options and a valid key. They do **not** certify semantic uniqueness by algorithm and are not a substitute for a second human reviewer or psychometric analysis.

## Twelve distractor revisions applied
| Library / set / question | Editorial change |
|---|---|
| Listening · `part3-hotel-reservation` · Q1 | Replaced unrelated hotel-service alternatives with other plausible booking requests. |
| Listening · `part3-client-presentation` · Q3 | Aligned all alternatives with realistic presentation-preparation actions. |
| Listening · `part4-training-registration` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives as plausible employee groups. |
| Reading · `business-travel` · Q2 | Made all alternatives plausible travel records while keeping reimbursement evidence unique. |
| Reading · `customer-refund-email` · Q1 | Replaced the unrelated hotel refund with realistic keyboard/order-resolution requests. |
| Reading · `supplier-invoice-followup` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives with common invoice/payment verification issues. |
| Reading · `double-passage-order` · Q1 | Replaced off-topic alternatives with plausible causes of a shipment delay. |
| Reading · `part7-double-equipment-order` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives with realistic supplier/order enquiries. |
| Reading · `part7-single-training-email` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives as plausible employee audiences. |

## Answer-position distribution — balanced with stable choice identity
| Part | A | B | C | D | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Part 3 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 9 | 39 |
| Part 4 | 8 | 8 | 7 | 7 | 30 |
| Part 7 | 43 | 43 | 43 | 42 | 171 |

**Rebalancing method:** 27 question groups had only the keyed option exchanged with a distractor position: 8 in Part 3, 5 in Part 4 and 14 in Part 7. The answer text, source evidence, explanation, question IDs and question order were retained. Each changed question carries `previousChoices` and `previousChoiceIds` from v2.16.0; the matching `choiceIds` moved with the option. At startup, progress containing a v2.16 `choiceId` is relocated to its new index; older records without an ID are mapped through the v2.16 snapshot. The prior index is preserved in `previousChoiceIndex`. No random shuffle was used.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Historical reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. For the new v2.92.0 and v2.93.0 Part 7 groups, close dates/times, locations, delivery steps and document-purpose alternatives were authored to be plausible, but an independent reviewer must confirm that exactly one option is defensible.
- Listening reserve total: 137 questions across 65 units. This script structurally checks Part 3/4 reserve blocks; Part 2 response-fit is tracked separately. Structural checks never approve a reserve for Mock.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 uses source-tracked licensed Pexels and AI-generated photographs with a JPG-only runtime contract; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

# Foundation A2 Assessment Quality Pass — v2.95.42

## Scope
- 13 core A2 Reading resources + 13 core A2 Listening resources; the new 13 supplementary A2 Listening clips (39 questions) are separately scoped and pending independent review.
- Focused review of within-resource q2/q3 repetition, answer-key uniqueness, four-choice integrity and explicit source traceability for changed/retained focus questions.
- Five question prompts/answer tasks were materially revised; six reviewed question records now carry exact source-evidence pointers.

## Automated integrity results
| Bank | A2 resources | A2 questions | A2 answer positions A/B/C/D |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Reading | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |
| Listening | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |

- All A2 questions require four unique choices, a valid answer index, a non-empty prompt and rationale.
- Each A2 resource must have three questions with non-identical q2/q3 correct answers.
- Each source-evidence pointer is checked as an exact substring of its Reading passage or spoken Listening segment.
- Core Reading answer positions remain A/B/C/D = 15/15/15/14; Listening full bank including supplementary practice is A/B/C/D = 25/25/24/24.
- Existing A2 q1/q2 objects remain protected by the v2.75.0 canonical-hash baseline tests.

## Focused changes
| Question | Change |
|---|---|
| `a2-quantities::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with a consequence/inference question about the delivery timing and preparation of training materials. |
| `a2-comparisons::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with an inference about the customer's priority: dependable, on-time delivery versus lowest price. |
| `a2-obligation-permission::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the separate departure requirement to return the visitor badge. |
| `a2-comparisons::listening1::q3` | Reworded q3 to test the stated reliability/on-time advantage; q2 remains byte-identical to the v2.75.0 baseline. |
| `a2-sequencing-instructions::listening1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the immediately preceding action before preparing the return label. |

## Review boundary
- The pass fixes five identified cases of repeated information and records six exact source pointers. It does not certify every distractor for semantic plausibility or uniqueness.
- The work is an internal single-author review. Independent second-person language review and psychometric validation remain pending.
- The local A2 three-question / 67% rule is a practice threshold only; it is not a CEFR standard, mastery declaration or ETS equivalence.

## Automated audit status
- **PASS** — all registered structural, source-evidence, pair-distinction and answer-position checks passed.

# Foundation A2 Assessment Quality Pass — v2.95.8

## Scope
- 13 core A2 Reading resources + 13 core A2 Listening resources; the new 13 supplementary A2 Listening clips (39 questions) are separately scoped and pending independent review.
- Focused review of within-resource q2/q3 repetition, answer-key uniqueness, four-choice integrity and explicit source traceability for changed/retained focus questions.
- Five question prompts/answer tasks were materially revised; six reviewed question records now carry exact source-evidence pointers.

## Automated integrity results
| Bank | A2 resources | A2 questions | A2 answer positions A/B/C/D |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Reading | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |
| Listening | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |

- All A2 questions require four unique choices, a valid answer index, a non-empty prompt and rationale.
- Each A2 resource must have three questions with non-identical q2/q3 correct answers.
- Each source-evidence pointer is checked as an exact substring of its Reading passage or spoken Listening segment.
- Core Reading answer positions remain A/B/C/D = 15/15/15/14; Listening full bank including supplementary practice is A/B/C/D = 25/25/24/24.
- Existing A2 q1/q2 objects remain protected by the v2.75.0 canonical-hash baseline tests.

## Focused changes
| Question | Change |
|---|---|
| `a2-quantities::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with a consequence/inference question about the delivery timing and preparation of training materials. |
| `a2-comparisons::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with an inference about the customer's priority: dependable, on-time delivery versus lowest price. |
| `a2-obligation-permission::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the separate departure requirement to return the visitor badge. |
| `a2-comparisons::listening1::q3` | Reworded q3 to test the stated reliability/on-time advantage; q2 remains byte-identical to the v2.75.0 baseline. |
| `a2-sequencing-instructions::listening1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the immediately preceding action before preparing the return label. |

## Review boundary
- The pass fixes five identified cases of repeated information and records six exact source pointers. It does not certify every distractor for semantic plausibility or uniqueness.
- The work is an internal single-author review. Independent second-person language review and psychometric validation remain pending.
- The local A2 three-question / 67% rule is a practice threshold only; it is not a CEFR standard, mastery declaration or ETS equivalence.

## Automated audit status
- **PASS** — all registered structural, source-evidence, pair-distinction and answer-position checks passed.

# Release Comparison — v2.95.24 → v2.95.25

| Area | v2.95.24 | v2.95.25 |
|---|---|---|
| Related glossary entries | 423 | 423 (stable) |
| Placeholder English definitions | 116 | 73 |
| Canonical-sense backfills | 0 in release | 43 cumulative |
| New related terms | — | 0 |
| Relationship edges changed | — | 0 |
| Vocabulary IDs | 1,141 | 1,141 (unchanged) |
| UI/CSS/layout | Frozen | Frozen |
| Cross-domain quality report | Earlier backlog report only | Added current audit JSON + Markdown |
| Backfill safety | — | Audit-only default; exact headword matching; idempotent; source traceability |
| CI | Existing suites | Added two test modules and compile targets |


## Why this is a major quality release

The release reduces the amount of generic placeholder English explanation in existing reference terms by reusing canonical bilingual headword senses. It adds a guarded tool, provenance, regression checks and an audit spanning vocabulary, glossary, practice inventory and learning-outcome instrumentation. It does not claim external dictionary review or learner mastery.

All 12 new Listening/Reading resources remain reserve-pending-independent-review and excluded from Mock eligibility. v2.93.0 batch 025 adds 9 Grammar lessons / 27 exercises, 8 TOEIC Listening units / 20 questions, 8 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 36 questions and 4 vocabulary headwords; new Listening/Reading items remain pending independent review and Mock-excluded.
- Foundation A–Z records TTS play-button actions in `toeic:alphabet-sound-progress:v1`; no pronunciation analysis or mastery inference is performed.
- Part 5 practice: pending independent review; do not count as Mock-eligible.
- Independent-review handoff queue: 193 Listening questions across 89 units + 87 Reading Part 7 questions across 22 resources + 80 separate Part 5 questions = 360 item-level decisions. Queue presence means traceable reviewer handoff only, not approval or Mock eligibility.
- Listening pending-review pool and Mock-eligible counts must be tracked separately from raw inventory.
- Placement is a short sample, not official CEFR/ETS certification.
- TOEIC score readiness is a local evidence tracker based on three completed 200-question Full Mocks; it shows L/R practice-accuracy trends only and does not convert raw accuracy into ETS scaled scores or claim 500+/850+ readiness.
- Remote CI, GitHub Pages deployment and physical-device QA are not inferred from local checks.

## Reporting rule

A percentage is shown only when a defensible target or denominator exists. Otherwise the report says “Chưa đo được” and records the current inventory without inventing a target.

# Foundation A2 Assessment Quality Pass — v2.95.44

## Scope
- 13 core A2 Reading resources + 13 core A2 Listening resources; the new 13 supplementary A2 Listening clips (39 questions) are separately scoped and pending independent review.
- Focused review of within-resource q2/q3 repetition, answer-key uniqueness, four-choice integrity and explicit source traceability for changed/retained focus questions.
- Five question prompts/answer tasks were materially revised; six reviewed question records now carry exact source-evidence pointers.

## Automated integrity results
| Bank | A2 resources | A2 questions | A2 answer positions A/B/C/D |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Reading | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |
| Listening | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |

- All A2 questions require four unique choices, a valid answer index, a non-empty prompt and rationale.
- Each A2 resource must have three questions with non-identical q2/q3 correct answers.
- Each source-evidence pointer is checked as an exact substring of its Reading passage or spoken Listening segment.
- Core Reading answer positions remain A/B/C/D = 15/15/15/14; Listening full bank including supplementary practice is A/B/C/D = 25/25/24/24.
- Existing A2 q1/q2 objects remain protected by the v2.75.0 canonical-hash baseline tests.

## Focused changes
| Question | Change |
|---|---|
| `a2-quantities::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with a consequence/inference question about the delivery timing and preparation of training materials. |
| `a2-comparisons::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with an inference about the customer's priority: dependable, on-time delivery versus lowest price. |
| `a2-obligation-permission::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the separate departure requirement to return the visitor badge. |
| `a2-comparisons::listening1::q3` | Reworded q3 to test the stated reliability/on-time advantage; q2 remains byte-identical to the v2.75.0 baseline. |
| `a2-sequencing-instructions::listening1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the immediately preceding action before preparing the return label. |

## Review boundary
- The pass fixes five identified cases of repeated information and records six exact source pointers. It does not certify every distractor for semantic plausibility or uniqueness.
- The work is an internal single-author review. Independent second-person language review and psychometric validation remain pending.
- The local A2 three-question / 67% rule is a practice threshold only; it is not a CEFR standard, mastery declaration or ETS equivalence.

## Automated audit status
- **PASS** — all registered structural, source-evidence, pair-distinction and answer-position checks passed.

# Related-term Glossary Expansion — v2.95.17

## Purpose

This batch closes nine remaining repeated gaps in the exact synonym/antonym lookup join. Each selected term occurs exactly twice in the current canonical relationship graph. The records are lookup glosses only; no relationship arrays were edited.

| Term | POS | Vietnamese gloss | Reference count | Cambridge source |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `choose` | v | chọn; quyết định muốn lấy hoặc sử dụng người hay vật nào trong các phương án | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/choose) |
| `distribution` | n | phân phối; sự phân phối hoặc cung ứng hàng hóa, dịch vụ | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/distribution) |
| `effect` | n/v | kết quả; tác động; tạo ra hoặc làm phát sinh một kết quả | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/effect) |
| `estimate` | n/v | ước tính; sự ước lượng hoặc con số ước tính | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/estimate) |
| `former` | adj | trước đây; thuộc về thời kỳ hoặc vị trí trong quá khứ | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/former) |
| `inform` | v | thông báo; cung cấp thông tin hoặc báo cho ai biết | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/inform) |
| `origin` | n | nguồn gốc; điểm hoặc nơi bắt đầu hay xuất phát | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/origin) |
| `possibility` | n | khả năng; điều có thể xảy ra hoặc phương án có thể lựa chọn | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/possibility) |
| `responsibility` | n | trách nhiệm; nghĩa vụ phải xử lý hoặc bảo đảm một việc được thực hiện | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/responsibility) |

## Coverage after the patch

- Related-term glossary: **396 entries**, up from 387.
- Exact case-insensitive join: **385/804** distinct referenced terms have a glossary entry (**47.9%**); **419** terms remain unglossed.
- Occurrence-level join: **590/1,037** occurrences have a glossary entry; **447** occurrences remain unglossed.
- The nine additions account for 18 previously unglossed relationship occurrences.
- The validator's informational related-term counter uses a different counting rule and is not compared directly with the exact case-insensitive join.

## Editorial status

**Provisional — independent lexical review pending.** The English definitions and Vietnamese glosses are concise paraphrases of the linked Cambridge entries. POS labels follow the forms used by the existing relationships. Review contextual sense fit before treating the records as editorially approved.

## Integrity boundary

No canonical headword, stable ID, topic, synonym/antonym relationship, word-family relation, question, answer key or learner record was modified. Provenance ledger: `data/vocabulary/batch-023.json`; safe patch: `patches-related-terms/v2.95.17/related-terms-001.json`.

## Quality / verification status

- Content counts do not equal completed learning outcomes.
- Outcome framework: 33/33 criteria defined; 6/33 have an evidence-collection path. Neither count measures learner mastery.
- TOEIC objective tracker: aggregates latest answer per stable unique question; minimum 10 unique items and 80% accuracy. A passing label is a practice threshold only, not CEFR/ETS certification or proof of every outcome.
- Objective evidence is connected for Grammar, Listening Parts 1–4, Reading Parts 5–7 and separate Part 5 practice. Reserve Listening items are excluded until editorial review; Reading Part 7 remains second-review-gated; the separate 80-item Part 5 practice pool is review-pending and cannot earn a threshold status.
- Listening Part 1 currently has 8 eligible unique questions (one additional mapped item is reserve-pending), below the 10-item minimum; at least 2 more unique, reviewed questions are needed before it can reach the practice threshold.
- Foundation outcome evidence now records recognition, a learner-authored sentence with three self-report explanation/production ratings, and delayed recall. Self-report is not auto-graded; delayed recall is scheduled 1/3 days and is not a retention guarantee.
- Foundation Listening stores attempts under a separate localStorage key; its bank coverage does not imply the learner has completed the questions or met the local practice threshold.
- Supplementary A2 Listening has 13 six-turn dialogues (75–100 words each), 39 questions across detail, purpose/context and inference/next-action, with exact source-evidence snippets; all remain pending independent review and use browser TTS.
- v2.92.0 batch 024 adds 8 Grammar lessons / 24 exercises, 6 TOEIC Listening units / 18 questions, and 6 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 27 questions. All 12 new Listening/Reading resources remain reserve-pending-independent-review and excluded from Mock eligibility. v2.93.0 batch 025 adds 9 Grammar lessons / 27 exercises, 8 TOEIC Listening units / 20 questions, 8 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 36 questions and 4 vocabulary headwords; new Listening/Reading items remain pending independent review and Mock-excluded.
- Foundation A–Z records TTS play-button actions in `toeic:alphabet-sound-progress:v1`; no pronunciation analysis or mastery inference is performed.
- Part 5 practice: pending independent review; do not count as Mock-eligible.
- Listening pending-review pool and Mock-eligible counts must be tracked separately from raw inventory.
- Placement is a short sample, not official CEFR/ETS certification.
- TOEIC score readiness is a local evidence tracker based on three completed 200-question Full Mocks; it shows L/R practice-accuracy trends only and does not convert raw accuracy into ETS scaled scores or claim 500+/850+ readiness.
- Remote CI, GitHub Pages deployment and physical-device QA are not inferred from local checks.

## Reporting rule

A percentage is shown only when a defensible target or denominator exists. Otherwise the report says “Chưa đo được” and records the current inventory without inventing a target.

## Reviewer record

- Reviewer name / role: ____________________________________
- Review date: _____________________________________________
- Review method / reference material: ________________________
- Decision key: `APPROVE` / `REVISE` / `REJECT` (record per item; do not approve a whole batch by default).

## A. Listening reserve

For Part 2, assess speech act, polarity, indirect response and naturalness. For Parts 3–4, assess transcript support and distractor plausibility. For Part 1, inspect the photo itself as well as the spoken statements.

### Part 1 · `part1-office-cleaning` · Sweeping an office hallway

- Batch: `017` · Status: `reserve-pending-independent-review`
- Transcript: A maintenance worker is sweeping the floor in a hallway. A cleaner is wiping the glass doors with a cloth. A worker is pushing a cleaning cart down the corridor. Several chairs are being arranged near the entrance.
- Spoken-statement translation / A–D mapping: A. Một nhân viên bảo trì đang quét sàn hành lang. B. Một nhân viên vệ sinh đang lau cửa kính bằng khăn. C. Một công nhân đang đẩy xe vệ sinh dọc hành lang. D. Một số chiếc ghế đang được sắp xếp gần lối vào.
- Photo: `./assets/listening/part1-office-cleaning.jpg` · Alt: A maintenance worker is sweeping the tiled floor of an office hallway with a broom. A cleaning cart stands nearby.
- Internal visual note (not independent approval): Image check: the worker is visibly using a broom to sweep the tiled hallway floor; the cleaning cart is stationary beside him. The image does not show wiping the glass doors, pushing the cart, or arranging chairs. This is an internal visual check, not independent certification.

**Q1. Listen to the four statements and select the one that best describes the photograph.**

- Choices: **A. Option A**<br>B. Option B<br>C. Option C<br>D. Option D
- Current keyed answer: **A. Option A**
- Source pointer: A maintenance worker is sweeping the floor in a hallway.
- Current explanation: Đáp án A: Người công nhân đang dùng chổi quét sàn hành lang. Xe vệ sinh chỉ đang đặt bên cạnh, không được đẩy đi. Ảnh không cho thấy người này lau cửa kính hoặc sắp xếp ghế.
- Reviewer: [ ] source supports key  [ ] response/action fits  [ ] distractors are clearly wrong  [ ] only one defensible answer
- Decision: `________` · Correction / notes: __________________________________________

### Part 2 · `part2-monitor-delivery-arrival` · Replacement monitor delivery

- Batch: `legacy` · Status: `reserve-pending-independent-review`
- Transcript: Has the replacement monitor arrived yet?
- Transcript translation: Màn hình thay thế đã được giao đến chưa? — Chưa; đơn vị chuyển phát dự kiến giao sau bữa trưa.

**Q1. Choose the most appropriate response.**

- Choices: A. The monitor has a wider screen.<br>**B. Not yet; the courier expects it after lunch.**<br>C. I ordered a desk lamp last week.

### `p5-sc-001` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The HR manager asked all new employees to __________ the orientation form by Friday.
- Choices: **A. complete**<br>B. completion<br>C. completely<br>D. completed
- Current keyed answer: **A. complete**
- Grammar point: Verb pattern: ask + object + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: “to” đứng ngay trước chỗ trống nên chỉ động từ nguyên mẫu “complete” phù hợp; các lựa chọn còn lại là danh từ, trạng từ hoặc quá khứ phân từ.

- Vietnamese translation: Nhân viên mới phải thích nghi với các quy trình an toàn của công ty trước khi bắt đầu làm việc.

### `p5-sc-080` · Adjectives and Adverbs

- Sentence: Payroll is processed __________, on the last working day of each month.
- Choices: A. month<br>**B. monthly**<br>C. monthly basis<br>D. month’s
- Current keyed answer: **B. monthly**
- Grammar point: Adverb of frequency: monthly
- Single-answer rationale: “Monthly” là trạng từ duy nhất có thể đứng độc lập ở vị trí này; “monthly basis” cần giới từ và mạo từ “on a”.
- Vietnamese translation: Bảng lương được xử lý hằng tháng, vào ngày làm việc cuối cùng của mỗi tháng.

**Rebalancing method:** 27 question groups had only the keyed option exchanged with a distractor position: 8 in Part 3, 5 in Part 4 and 14 in Part 7. The answer text, source evidence, explanation, question IDs and question order were retained. Each changed question carries `previousChoices` and `previousChoiceIds` from v2.16.0; the matching `choiceIds` moved with the option. At startup, progress containing a v2.16 `choiceId` is relocated to its new index; older records without an ID are mapped through the v2.16 snapshot. The prior index is preserved in `previousChoiceIndex`. No random shuffle was used.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Historical reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. For the new v2.92.0 and v2.93.0 Part 7 groups, close dates/times, locations, delivery steps and document-purpose alternatives were authored to be plausible, but an independent reviewer must confirm that exactly one option is defensible.
- Listening reserve total: 193 questions across 89 units. This script structurally checks Part 3/4 reserve blocks; Part 2 response-fit is tracked separately. Structural checks never approve a reserve for Mock.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 uses source-tracked licensed Pexels and AI-generated photographs with a JPG-only runtime contract; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

## Reviewer record

- Reviewer name / role: ____________________________________
- Review date: _____________________________________________
- Review method / reference material: ________________________
- Decision key: `APPROVE` / `REVISE` / `REJECT` (record per item; do not approve a whole batch by default).

- For revision: record the exact field and proposed correction; keep the item out of Mock until the correction is retested.

## A. Listening reserve

For Part 2, assess speech act, polarity, indirect response and naturalness. For Parts 3–4, assess transcript support and distractor plausibility. For Part 1, inspect the photo itself as well as the spoken statements.

### Part 1 · `part1-office-cleaning` · Sweeping an office hallway

- Batch: `017` · Status: `reserve-pending-independent-review`
- Transcript: A maintenance worker is sweeping the floor in a hallway. A cleaner is wiping the glass doors with a cloth. A worker is pushing a cleaning cart down the corridor. Several chairs are being arranged near the entrance.
- Spoken-statement translation / A–D mapping: A. Một nhân viên bảo trì đang quét sàn hành lang. B. Một nhân viên vệ sinh đang lau cửa kính bằng khăn. C. Một công nhân đang đẩy xe vệ sinh dọc hành lang. D. Một số chiếc ghế đang được sắp xếp gần lối vào.
- Photo: `./assets/listening/part1-office-cleaning.jpg` · Alt: A maintenance worker is sweeping the tiled floor of an office hallway with a broom. A cleaning cart stands nearby.
- Internal visual note (not independent approval): Image check: the worker is visibly using a broom to sweep the tiled hallway floor; the cleaning cart is stationary beside him. The image does not show wiping the glass doors, pushing the cart, or arranging chairs. This is an internal visual check, not independent certification.

**Q1. Listen to the four statements and select the one that best describes the photograph.**

This 80-question bank is separate from Reading Part 5 and must not be counted as Mock-eligible. Check the complete sentence, grammar focus, distractors, translation and every option explanation.

### `p5-sc-001` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The HR manager asked all new employees to __________ the orientation form by Friday.
- Choices: **A. complete**<br>B. completion<br>C. completely<br>D. completed
- Current keyed answer: **A. complete**
- Grammar point: Verb pattern: ask + object + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: “to” đứng ngay trước chỗ trống nên chỉ động từ nguyên mẫu “complete” phù hợp; các lựa chọn còn lại là danh từ, trạng từ hoặc quá khứ phân từ.
- Vietnamese translation: Quản lý nhân sự yêu cầu tất cả nhân viên mới hoàn thành biểu mẫu định hướng trước thứ Sáu.

# Related-term Glossary Expansion — v2.95.15

## Purpose

This batch fills the four highest-frequency remaining gaps in the exact synonym/antonym term join. Each selected term occurs at least three times in existing canonical vocabulary relationships. The additions are lookup glosses only; no synonym/antonym relationship or canonical headword was changed.

| Term | POS | Vietnamese gloss | Current reference count | Source |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `aim` | n | mục tiêu; mục đích; điều hướng tới hoặc nhằm đạt được | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/aim) |
| `avoid` | v | tránh; né; phòng tránh hoặc ngăn điều gì xảy ra | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/avoid) |
| `cause` | n/v | nguyên nhân; lý do; gây ra hoặc khiến điều gì xảy ra | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cause) |
| `conceal` | v | che giấu; giấu đi; giữ kín để người khác không nhìn thấy hoặc biết được | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/conceal) |

## Coverage after the patch

- Related-term glossary: **387 entries**, up from 383.
- Canonical synonym/antonym data references: **804 distinct terms** across **1,037 occurrences**.
- Exact case-insensitive term join: **376/804** distinct terms have a glossary entry; **428** distinct terms remain without one.
- At occurrence level: **465/1,037** synonym/antonym links still reference a term without a gloss.
- The four additions account for 12 previously unglossed link occurrences.
- The validator's informational counter now reports `321/804` under its own legacy counting rule. It is not the same measure as the exact case-insensitive term join above and should not be compared as though the denominators were defined identically.

## Editorial status

**Provisional — independent lexical review pending.** Cambridge Dictionary entries support the concise English definitions and the Vietnamese paraphrases. The POS labels reflect the forms used by the existing relationship graph: `aim` as a noun; `avoid` and `conceal` as verbs; `cause` as noun/verb. A reviewer should still confirm contextual sense fit before approval.

## Integrity boundary

No headword, stable ID, topic, synonym array, antonym array, word-family relation, question, answer key or learner record was modified. Provenance ledger: `data/vocabulary/batch-022.json`; safe patch: `patches-related-terms/v2.95.15/related-terms-001.json`.

### `p5-sc-001` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The HR manager asked all new employees to __________ the orientation form by Friday.
- Choices: **A. complete**<br>B. completion<br>C. completely<br>D. completed
- Current keyed answer: **A. complete**
- Grammar point: Verb pattern: ask + object + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: “to” đứng ngay trước chỗ trống nên chỉ động từ nguyên mẫu “complete” phù hợp; các lựa chọn còn lại là danh từ, trạng từ hoặc quá khứ phân từ.

- Vietnamese translation: Nhân viên mới phải thích nghi với các quy trình an toàn của công ty trước khi bắt đầu làm việc.
- Reviewer: [ ] grammar correct  [ ] sentence natural  [ ] distractors wrong  [ ] translation/explanations accurate  [ ] one defensible answer
- Decision: `________` · Correction / notes: __________________________________________

### `p5-sc-080` · Adjectives and Adverbs

- Sentence: Payroll is processed __________, on the last working day of each month.
- Choices: A. month<br>**B. monthly**<br>C. monthly basis<br>D. month’s
- Current keyed answer: **B. monthly**
- Grammar point: Adverb of frequency: monthly
- Single-answer rationale: “Monthly” là trạng từ duy nhất có thể đứng độc lập ở vị trí này; “monthly basis” cần giới từ và mạo từ “on a”.
- Vietnamese translation: Bảng lương được xử lý hằng tháng, vào ngày làm việc cuối cùng của mỗi tháng.
- Reviewer: [ ] grammar correct  [ ] sentence natural  [ ] distractors wrong  [ ] translation/explanations accurate  [ ] one defensible answer
- Decision: `________` · Correction / notes: __________________________________________

## Release rule

- The current 102 eligible Listening questions remain the only approved Listening pool; the 137 reserve questions are not promoted by this packet.
- Part 7 reserve remains excluded from Mock approval until item-level independent review is recorded.
- Part 5 sentence completion remains separate practice content; its review status must be changed only after item-level sign-off.
- A structural pass, traceable evidence quote or AI-assisted audit is not a substitute for the independent reviewer decision.

## Quality / verification status

- Content counts do not equal completed learning outcomes.
- Outcome framework: 33/33 criteria defined; 6/33 have an evidence-collection path. Neither count measures learner mastery.
- TOEIC objective tracker: aggregates latest answer per stable unique question; minimum 10 unique items and 80% accuracy. A passing label is a practice threshold only, not CEFR/ETS certification or proof of every outcome.
- Objective evidence is connected for Grammar, Listening Parts 1–4, Reading Parts 5–7 and separate Part 5 practice. Reserve Listening items are excluded until editorial review; Reading Part 7 remains second-review-gated; the separate 80-item Part 5 practice pool is review-pending and cannot earn a threshold status.
- Listening Part 1 currently has 8 eligible unique questions (one additional mapped item is reserve-pending), below the 10-item minimum; at least 2 more unique, reviewed questions are needed before it can reach the practice threshold.
- Foundation outcome evidence now records recognition, a learner-authored sentence with three self-report explanation/production ratings, and delayed recall. Self-report is not auto-graded; delayed recall is scheduled 1/3 days and is not a retention guarantee.
- Foundation Listening stores attempts under a separate localStorage key; its bank coverage does not imply the learner has completed the questions or met the local practice threshold.
- Supplementary A2 Listening has 13 six-turn dialogues (75–100 words each), 39 questions across detail, purpose/context and inference/next-action, with exact source-evidence snippets; all remain pending independent review and use browser TTS.
- v2.92.0 batch 024 adds 8 Grammar lessons / 24 exercises, 6 TOEIC Listening units / 18 questions, and 6 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 27 questions. All 12 new Listening/Reading resources remain reserve-pending-independent-review and excluded from Mock eligibility. v2.93.0 batch 025 adds 9 Grammar lessons / 27 exercises, 8 TOEIC Listening units / 20 questions, 8 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 36 questions and 4 vocabulary headwords; new Listening/Reading items remain pending independent review and Mock-excluded.
- Foundation A–Z records TTS play-button actions in `toeic:alphabet-sound-progress:v1`; no pronunciation analysis or mastery inference is performed.
- Part 5 practice: pending independent review; do not count as Mock-eligible.
- Independent-review handoff queue: 161 Listening questions across 73 units + 87 Reading Part 7 questions across 22 resources + 80 separate Part 5 questions = 328 item-level decisions. Queue presence means traceable reviewer handoff only, not approval or Mock eligibility.
- Listening pending-review pool and Mock-eligible counts must be tracked separately from raw inventory.
- Placement is a short sample, not official CEFR/ETS certification.
- TOEIC score readiness is a local evidence tracker based on three completed 200-question Full Mocks; it shows L/R practice-accuracy trends only and does not convert raw accuracy into ETS scaled scores or claim 500+/850+ readiness.
- Remote CI, GitHub Pages deployment and physical-device QA are not inferred from local checks.

## Reporting rule

A percentage is shown only when a defensible target or denominator exists. Otherwise the report says “Chưa đo được” and records the current inventory without inventing a target.

# Change Manifest — TOEIC Dictionary v2.95.17

## Release summary

A glossary-only content batch that fills nine repeated gaps in existing synonym/antonym references. Packaging remains governed by the one-root, committed-source-only ZIP tool introduced in v2.95.16.

## Canonical data delta

| Item | v2.95.16 | v2.95.17 | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Canonical vocabulary headwords | 1,141 | 1,141 | 0 |
| Related-term glossary entries | 387 | 396 | +9 |
| Distinct synonym/antonym terms with glossary entries | 376/804 | 385/804 | +9 |
| Unglossed distinct referenced terms | 428 | 419 | -9 |
| Unglossed reference occurrences | 465 | 447 | -18 |

New lookup terms: `choose`, `distribution`, `effect`, `estimate`, `former`, `inform`, `origin`, `possibility`, `responsibility`. Each is referenced exactly twice in the unchanged canonical synonym/antonym graph.

## Files changed / added

- `data/related-terms.json` — nine lookup records appended and sorted.
- `data/vocabulary/batch-023.json` — provenance ledger, POS scope, concise English paraphrases, Vietnamese glosses and Cambridge URLs.
- `patches-related-terms/v2.95.17/related-terms-001.json` — absent-only patch with exact base-file SHA-256.
- `tools/tests/test_related_glossary_batch_023.py` — nine regression checks for metadata, provenance, linkage, POS, reference frequency, uniqueness and CI registration.
- `tools/tests/test_related_glossary_batch_022.py` and `tools/tests/vocabulary-release-integrity.mjs` — historical release assertions remain valid after glossary expansion; JavaScript release check now includes Batch 023.
- `tools/report-project-progress.py` and `tools/tests/test_project_progress.py` — adds exact related-term join coverage as a measured progress metric.
- `.github/workflows/validate-data.yml` — registers Batch 023 and the package-source tests in syntax/unit steps.
- Version markers, changelog, master ledger, current/previous version docs, README, progress snapshot and release reports updated.

## Integrity boundary

No canonical headword, stable ID, topic array, synonym/antonym relationship, word-family link, exam question, answer key, learner record, IndexedDB schema, localStorage key or runtime data structure was changed. Only release-version markers changed in app/service-worker/UI shell metadata. All nine glosses remain provisional pending independent lexical review.

## Delivery boundary

Local candidate only. No GitHub push, GitHub Actions execution, GitHub Pages deployment or owner-run device acceptance was performed.

## Quality / verification status

- Content counts do not equal completed learning outcomes.
- Outcome framework: 33/33 criteria defined; 6/33 have an evidence-collection path. Neither count measures learner mastery.
- TOEIC objective tracker: aggregates latest answer per stable unique question; minimum 10 unique items and 80% accuracy. A passing label is a practice threshold only, not CEFR/ETS certification or proof of every outcome.
- Objective evidence is connected for Grammar, Listening Parts 1–4, Reading Parts 5–7 and separate Part 5 practice. Reserve Listening items are excluded until editorial review; Reading Part 7 remains second-review-gated; the separate 80-item Part 5 practice pool is review-pending and cannot earn a threshold status.
- Listening Part 1 currently has 8 eligible unique questions (one additional mapped item is reserve-pending), below the 10-item minimum; at least 2 more unique, reviewed questions are needed before it can reach the practice threshold.
- Foundation outcome evidence now records recognition, a learner-authored sentence with three self-report explanation/production ratings, and delayed recall. Self-report is not auto-graded; delayed recall is scheduled 1/3 days and is not a retention guarantee.
- Foundation Listening stores attempts under a separate localStorage key; its bank coverage does not imply the learner has completed the questions or met the local practice threshold.
- Supplementary A2 Listening has 13 six-turn dialogues (75–100 words each), 39 questions across detail, purpose/context and inference/next-action, with exact source-evidence snippets; all remain pending independent review and use browser TTS.
- v2.92.0 batch 024 adds 8 Grammar lessons / 24 exercises, 6 TOEIC Listening units / 18 questions, and 6 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 27 questions. All 12 new Listening/Reading resources remain reserve-pending-independent-review and excluded from Mock eligibility. v2.93.0 batch 025 adds 9 Grammar lessons / 27 exercises, 8 TOEIC Listening units / 20 questions, 8 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 36 questions and 4 vocabulary headwords; new Listening/Reading items remain pending independent review and Mock-excluded.
- Foundation A–Z records TTS play-button actions in `toeic:alphabet-sound-progress:v1`; no pronunciation analysis or mastery inference is performed.
- Part 5 practice: pending independent review; do not count as Mock-eligible.
- Independent-review handoff queue: 137 Listening questions across 65 units + 63 Reading Part 7 questions across 14 resources + 80 separate Part 5 questions = 280 item-level decisions. Queue presence means traceable reviewer handoff only, not approval or Mock eligibility.
- Listening pending-review pool and Mock-eligible counts must be tracked separately from raw inventory.
- Placement is a short sample, not official CEFR/ETS certification.
- TOEIC score readiness is a local evidence tracker based on three completed 200-question Full Mocks; it shows L/R practice-accuracy trends only and does not convert raw accuracy into ETS scaled scores or claim 500+/850+ readiness.
- Remote CI, GitHub Pages deployment and physical-device QA are not inferred from local checks.

## Reporting rule

A percentage is shown only when a defensible target or denominator exists. Otherwise the report says “Chưa đo được” and records the current inventory without inventing a target.


## Continuation verification (read-only glossary audit)

A deterministic, read-only candidate audit was added and registered in CI. It prioritizes unglossed synonym/antonym references by occurrence count, marks whether canonical headwords exist, and flags basic placeholder definitions. Current data reconciles at 430 glossary entries, 419/804 covered, 385 missing distinct terms / 386 references. No vocabulary, glossary, relation graph, question content, learner data or UI changes. Candidate-audit tests 3/3 PASS; focused related glossary/backfill/major-audit modules 21/21 PASS; JavaScript suites 39/39 PASS; data/content/repository validators and version sync PASS. Full Python discovery and external acceptance remain incomplete.

- Candidate audit improved with canonical-sense previews, single-/multi-sense/no-headword review tiers, and definition inventory categories.
- Definition audit counts: 229 missing English definitions, 73 placeholders, 128 non-placeholder definitions (430 entries).
- Focused tests 4/4 PASS; Batch 028 4/4; Backfill 025 6/6; Major Quality Audit 025 8/8; MJS regression 39/39; validators and version sync PASS.
- Runtime, vocabulary, relationship, learning-question and learner data remained untouched.
- Full Python unittest discovery attempt timed out; a repository-Git-dependent test also fails when run in this extracted workspace without `.git` metadata. This remains unverified, not a release PASS.

Read-only audit now scans definition/POS/provenance fields for review signals. 430 rows scanned, 305 rows flagged (overlapping counts: 229 missing English, 73 placeholders, 302 missing POS, 75 missing provenance, 1 short-definition signal). Focused tests 4/4 PASS. No runtime data changed.

## v2.95.9 Robot Buddy behavior boundary

- Robot Buddy retains the head-only mascot, static dialogue library, feature guidance, quick prompts, Placement consent/skip, reminder controls and idle safeguards.
- Optional Learning Insights uses an in-memory snapshot passed by the app from already-loaded local records. The aggregator is read-only and does not open IndexedDB/localStorage, write progress, migrate records or transmit data.
- Progress analysis appears as one visual dashboard; duplicate prose statistics are suppressed. It is not an ETS score prediction or proof of mastery.


## v2.95.9 Robot Buddy response improvement

- Standard chat responses now stream progressively in the UI rather than appearing as a complete block after the thinking delay.
- Local responses are composed from phrase groups and the current in-memory app/item context; repeated supported prompts can vary their wording.
- Unknown prompts ask for clarification instead of repeating the previous generic limitation sentence.
- This remains an offline scripted/rule-based companion, not a generative AI assistant. No external API, learner-data transmission or learner-storage change was added.
- Automated test evidence is recorded in `TEST_REPORT_TOEIC_Dictionary_v2.95.9.md`; physical/browser acceptance remains pending.

# Test Report — TOEIC Dictionary v2.95.21

## Scope

- Baseline: v2.95.20 FullSource.
- Candidate: v2.95.21.
- Changes: 23 related-term glossary lookup records, provenance/patch tooling, one stale project-progress expectation, release docs and test/CI coverage.
- No UI/CSS/layout/navigation/runtime behavior change.

## Local verification results

| Check | Result | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Batch 027 glossary regression | **5/5 PASS** | 23 terms, Cambridge source URLs, frequency priority, absent-only provenance patch, unchanged 1,141-word identity set and exact coverage. |
| Batch 026 regression | **5/5 PASS** | Existing previous batch remains compatible. |
| Related-term patch safety | **11/11 PASS** | Guarded patch, duplicate/absent checks and rollback/error handling. |
| Project-progress regression | **4/4 PASS** | Current 412/804 exact coverage and 392/393 missing-gap counts. |
| CI-coverage regression | **3/3 PASS** | New test and compile steps are registered in workflow. |
| Version-sync regression | **12/12 PASS** | Version markers and changelog/document pointers remain synchronized. |
| Focused Python total | **50/50 PASS** | Nine modules: the six main focused suites plus distractor-quality (6), repository-integrity (1) and package-source (3); not the entire Python inventory. |
| Python compilation | **PASS** | `python -m compileall -q tools`. |
| Package-source regression | **3/3 PASS** | One-root ZIP, tracked-only, dirty-tree refusal and version contract tests. |
| JavaScript regression | **38/38 PASS** | Every `tools/tests/*.mjs` suite executed independently. |
| JavaScript syntax | **PASS** | `sw.js` and every `assets/js/*.js` module checked via Node. |
| Vocabulary validator | **PASS** | 1,141 records; 0 IDs added / 0 missing; 0 errors / 0 warnings against the retained legacy baseline. |
| Learning-content validator | **PASS** | Listening 121 units /239 questions; Reading 65 /263; Grammar 50 /137; Part 5 practice 80; 0 errors / 0 warnings. |
| Repository integrity | **PASS** | 393 local references/data files; 0 errors; 0 optional warnings. |
| Listening/Reading evidence audit | **PASS** | 502 indexed questions; 137 Listening reserve items remain pending independent review. |
| Release-integrity Node test | **PASS** | 1,141 canonical headwords and current historical release/patch guards. |
| Version synchronization check | **PASS** | All current app/document version markers report 2.95.21. |

## Aggregate Python suite limitation

`python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v` was attempted with a 240-second execution limit. It did not complete before the limit and stopped while processing `test_patch_data.py`. # Robot Buddy privacy refinement — v2.95.25

## Change
When Learning Insights is toggled OFF, the app now removes all rendered `.robot-progress-dashboard` elements from the Robot Buddy chat panel immediately. It preserves unrelated conversation messages. The opt-in setting and existing analysis boundary remain unchanged.

## Why
A previously rendered local snapshot could remain visible after the user disabled analysis. Although this was not a new data read, clearing the dashboard avoids ambiguity about whether progress insights are still active.

## Validation
- Updated `tools/tests/robot-buddy-data-boundary.mjs` with checks for dashboard cleanup and disable-gate behavior.
- Robot Buddy boundary regression: PASS.
- Full JavaScript suite count: 39 suites (run separately).
- Python full discovery: attempted but did not complete within the execution limit; results are not represented as a full-suite pass.
- Vocabulary and learning-content validators: PASS, 0 errors / 0 warnings.
- Version synchronization: PASS.

## Scope
No UI layout redesign, learner-record deletion, data-store changes, or network access was added. This change is confined to the existing v2.95.25 release.

**Rebalancing method:** 27 question groups had only the keyed option exchanged with a distractor position: 8 in Part 3, 5 in Part 4 and 14 in Part 7. The answer text, source evidence, explanation, question IDs and question order were retained. Each changed question carries `previousChoices` and `previousChoiceIds` from v2.16.0; the matching `choiceIds` moved with the option. At startup, progress containing a v2.16 `choiceId` is relocated to its new index; older records without an ID are mapped through the v2.16 snapshot. The prior index is preserved in `previousChoiceIndex`. No random shuffle was used.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Historical reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. For the new v2.92.0 and v2.93.0 Part 7 groups, close dates/times, locations, delivery steps and document-purpose alternatives were authored to be plausible, but an independent reviewer must confirm that exactly one option is defensible.
- Listening reserve total: 137 questions across 65 units. This script structurally checks Part 3/4 reserve blocks; Part 2 response-fit is tracked separately. Structural checks never approve a reserve for Mock.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 uses source-tracked licensed Pexels and AI-generated photographs with a JPG-only runtime contract; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

# Foundation A2 Assessment Quality Pass — v2.95.18

## Scope
- 13 core A2 Reading resources + 13 core A2 Listening resources; the new 13 supplementary A2 Listening clips (39 questions) are separately scoped and pending independent review.
- Focused review of within-resource q2/q3 repetition, answer-key uniqueness, four-choice integrity and explicit source traceability for changed/retained focus questions.
- Five question prompts/answer tasks were materially revised; six reviewed question records now carry exact source-evidence pointers.

## Automated integrity results
| Bank | A2 resources | A2 questions | A2 answer positions A/B/C/D |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Reading | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |
| Listening | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |

- All A2 questions require four unique choices, a valid answer index, a non-empty prompt and rationale.
- Each A2 resource must have three questions with non-identical q2/q3 correct answers.
- Each source-evidence pointer is checked as an exact substring of its Reading passage or spoken Listening segment.
- Core Reading answer positions remain A/B/C/D = 15/15/15/14; Listening full bank including supplementary practice is A/B/C/D = 25/25/24/24.
- Existing A2 q1/q2 objects remain protected by the v2.75.0 canonical-hash baseline tests.

## Focused changes
| Question | Change |
|---|---|
| `a2-quantities::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with a consequence/inference question about the delivery timing and preparation of training materials. |
| `a2-comparisons::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with an inference about the customer's priority: dependable, on-time delivery versus lowest price. |
| `a2-obligation-permission::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the separate departure requirement to return the visitor badge. |
| `a2-comparisons::listening1::q3` | Reworded q3 to test the stated reliability/on-time advantage; q2 remains byte-identical to the v2.75.0 baseline. |
| `a2-sequencing-instructions::listening1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the immediately preceding action before preparing the return label. |

## Review boundary
- The pass fixes five identified cases of repeated information and records six exact source pointers. It does not certify every distractor for semantic plausibility or uniqueness.
- The work is an internal single-author review. Independent second-person language review and psychometric validation remain pending.
- The local A2 three-question / 67% rule is a practice threshold only; it is not a CEFR standard, mastery declaration or ETS equivalence.

## Automated audit status
- **PASS** — all registered structural, source-evidence, pair-distinction and answer-position checks passed.

# Related-term Glossary Expansion — v2.95.21 (Batch 027)

## Purpose and selection

Continue the existing glossary work rather than replacing it with a new workstream. Batch 027 prioritizes the 23 source-verified highest-frequency terms that were still missing from the case-insensitive lookup join and each appeared exactly twice in the canonical synonym/antonym graph. Terms without a confirmed Cambridge lookup page were deliberately deferred.

| Term | POS | Vietnamese lookup gloss | References | Cambridge source |

| `activity` | n | hoạt động; hoạt động kinh doanh | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/activity) |
| `answer` | n/v | câu trả lời; lời giải; trả lời hoặc phản hồi | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/answer) |

| `combination` | n | sự kết hợp; sự kết hợp của nhiều yếu tố | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/combination) |
| `common` | adj | phổ biến; thường gặp | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/common) |
| `continue` | v | tiếp tục; duy trì; tiếp diễn | 2 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/continue) |

- Canonical vocabulary: **1,141 headwords**; stable ID set unchanged.

The patch adds only absent related-term lookup records and is tied to the exact pre-patch SHA-256 of `data/related-terms.json`. No canonical headword, stable ID, topic, synonym/antonym relation, word-family relation, question, answer key, learner record, storage key or runtime behavior was changed. ## Answer-position distribution — balanced with stable choice identity

**Rebalancing method:** 27 question groups had only the keyed option exchanged with a distractor position: 8 in Part 3, 5 in Part 4 and 14 in Part 7. The answer text, source evidence, explanation, question IDs and question order were retained. Each changed question carries `previousChoices` and `previousChoiceIds` from v2.16.0; the matching `choiceIds` moved with the option. At startup, progress containing a v2.16 `choiceId` is relocated to its new index; older records without an ID are mapped through the v2.16 snapshot. The prior index is preserved in `previousChoiceIndex`. No random shuffle was used.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Historical reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. For the new v2.92.0 and v2.93.0 Part 7 groups, close dates/times, locations, delivery steps and document-purpose alternatives were authored to be plausible, but an independent reviewer must confirm that exactly one option is defensible.
- Listening reserve total: 137 questions across 65 units. This script structurally checks Part 3/4 reserve blocks; Part 2 response-fit is tracked separately. Structural checks never approve a reserve for Mock.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 uses source-tracked licensed Pexels and AI-generated photographs with a JPG-only runtime contract; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

# TOEIC Independent Editorial Review Queue — v2.95.19

> Mục đích: chuyển nội dung reserve cho người rà soát độc lập. Đây là phiếu làm việc, không phải chứng nhận đã duyệt. Không đổi `editorialStatus` sang `approved-for-mock` cho đến khi reviewer ghi quyết định và ngày rà soát.

## Queue summary

| Bank | Items pending | Resources | Required review |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Listening Parts 1–4 | 137 | 65 units | Source/key fit, response fit, distractor uniqueness; P1 photo/action match |
| Reading Part 7 | 63 | 14 resources | Document evidence, inference, cross-document links, one-best-answer uniqueness |
| Separate Part 5 sentence completion | 80 | 1 bank | Grammar, naturalness, distractors, translation and one-answer uniqueness |
| **Total** | **280** | **80** | **Independent review required** |

## Reviewer record

- Reviewer name / role: ____________________________________
- Review date: _____________________________________________
- Review method / reference material: ________________________
- Decision key: `APPROVE` / `REVISE` / `REJECT` (record per item; do not approve a whole batch by default).
- For approval: confirm one defensible key, all distractors are wrong in context, source evidence supports the key, and explanation/translation are accurate.
- For revision: record the exact field and proposed correction; keep the item out of Mock until the correction is retested.

## A. Listening reserve

For Part 2, assess speech act, polarity, indirect response and naturalness. For Parts 3–4, assess transcript support and distractor plausibility. For Part 1, inspect the photo itself as well as the spoken statements.

### Part 1 · `part1-office-cleaning` · Sweeping an office hallway

- Batch: `017` · Status: `reserve-pending-independent-review`
- Transcript: A maintenance worker is sweeping the floor in a hallway. A cleaner is wiping the glass doors with a cloth. A worker is pushing a cleaning cart down the corridor. Several chairs are being arranged near the entrance.
- Spoken-statement translation / A–D mapping: A. Một nhân viên bảo trì đang quét sàn hành lang. B. Một nhân viên vệ sinh đang lau cửa kính bằng khăn. C. Một công nhân đang đẩy xe vệ sinh dọc hành lang. D. Một số chiếc ghế đang được sắp xếp gần lối vào.
- Photo: `./assets/listening/part1-office-cleaning.jpg` · Alt: A maintenance worker is sweeping the tiled floor of an office hallway with a broom. A cleaning cart stands nearby.
- Internal visual note (not independent approval): Image check: the worker is visibly using a broom to sweep the tiled hallway floor; the cleaning cart is stationary beside him. The image does not show wiping the glass doors, pushing the cart, or arranging chairs. This is an internal visual check, not independent certification.

**Q1. Listen to the four statements and select the one that best describes the photograph.**

- Choices: **A. Option A**<br>B. Option B<br>C. Option C<br>D. Option D

### `p5-sc-001` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The HR manager asked all new employees to __________ the orientation form by Friday.
- Choices: **A. complete**<br>B. completion<br>C. completely<br>D. completed
- Current keyed answer: **A. complete**
- Grammar point: Verb pattern: ask + object + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: “to” đứng ngay trước chỗ trống nên chỉ động từ nguyên mẫu “complete” phù hợp; các lựa chọn còn lại là danh từ, trạng từ hoặc quá khứ phân từ.
- Vietnamese translation: Quản lý nhân sự yêu cầu tất cả nhân viên mới hoàn thành biểu mẫu định hướng trước thứ Sáu.
