# Foundation A2 Assessment Quality Pass — v2.95.33

## Scope
- 13 core A2 Reading resources + 13 core A2 Listening resources; the new 13 supplementary A2 Listening clips (39 questions) are separately scoped and pending independent review.
- Focused review of within-resource q2/q3 repetition, answer-key uniqueness, four-choice integrity and explicit source traceability for changed/retained focus questions.
- Five question prompts/answer tasks were materially revised; six reviewed question records now carry exact source-evidence pointers.

## Automated integrity results
| Bank | A2 resources | A2 questions | A2 answer positions A/B/C/D |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Reading | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |
| Listening | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |

- All A2 questions require four unique choices, a valid answer index, a non-empty prompt and rationale.
- Each A2 resource must have three questions with non-identical q2/q3 correct answers.
- Each source-evidence pointer is checked as an exact substring of its Reading passage or spoken Listening segment.
- Core Reading answer positions remain A/B/C/D = 15/15/15/14; Listening full bank including supplementary practice is A/B/C/D = 25/25/24/24.
- Existing A2 q1/q2 objects remain protected by the v2.75.0 canonical-hash baseline tests.

## Focused changes
| Question | Change |
|---|---|
| `a2-quantities::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with a consequence/inference question about the delivery timing and preparation of training materials. |
| `a2-comparisons::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with an inference about the customer's priority: dependable, on-time delivery versus lowest price. |
| `a2-obligation-permission::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the separate departure requirement to return the visitor badge. |
| `a2-comparisons::listening1::q3` | Reworded q3 to test the stated reliability/on-time advantage; q2 remains byte-identical to the v2.75.0 baseline. |
| `a2-sequencing-instructions::listening1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the immediately preceding action before preparing the return label. |

## Review boundary
- The pass fixes five identified cases of repeated information and records six exact source pointers. It does not certify every distractor for semantic plausibility or uniqueness.
- The work is an internal single-author review. Independent second-person language review and psychometric validation remain pending.
- The local A2 three-question / 67% rule is a practice threshold only; it is not a CEFR standard, mastery declaration or ETS equivalence.

## Automated audit status
- **PASS** — all registered structural, source-evidence, pair-distinction and answer-position checks passed.

# Related-term Glossary Expansion — v2.95.14

## Purpose

This batch fills ten Vietnamese gloss gaps for terms already used in the canonical synonym/antonym relationships. It adds supporting explanations without changing the relationship graph or canonical word list.

| Term | POS | Vietnamese gloss | Existing synonym/antonym references | Source |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `requirement` | n | điều kiện; yêu cầu bắt buộc | 4 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/requirement) |
| `pay` | n/v | tiền lương; khoản thanh toán; trả tiền hoặc trả lương | 4 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/pay) |
| `ignore` | v | phớt lờ; không chú ý đến | 4 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/ignore) |
| `withhold` | v | giữ lại; không cung cấp hoặc chi trả | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/withhold) |
| `retain` | v | giữ lại; duy trì; giữ chân | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/retain) |
| `earnings` | n (plural) | thu nhập; tiền kiếm được từ công việc; lợi nhuận doanh nghiệp | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/earnings) |
| `duty` | n | nhiệm vụ; nghĩa vụ; trách nhiệm | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/duty) |
| `distribute` | v | phân phát; phân phối; cung ứng | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/distribute) |
| `discourage` | v | làm nản lòng; khiến ai ít sẵn lòng; ngăn cản | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/discourage) |
| `decline` | n/v | giảm; suy giảm; từ chối; sự suy giảm | 3 | [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/decline) |

## Coverage after the patch

- Related-term glossary: **383 entries**, up from 373.
- Canonical synonym/antonym data references: **804 distinct terms** across **1,037 occurrences**.
- Exact case-insensitive term join: **372/804** distinct terms now have a glossary entry; **432** distinct terms remain without one.
- At occurrence level: **477/1,037** synonym/antonym links still reference a term without a gloss.
- The ten additions account for 33 previously unglossed link occurrences.

The validator's informational text `syn/ant chưa có nghĩa=323/804` is produced by a different legacy counting rule. It is recorded as-is and is not treated as interchangeable with the exact-term join above.

## Editorial status

**Provisional — independent lexical review pending.** Cambridge pages were used as source references for short English definitions and Vietnamese paraphrases. Because these words can have multiple senses and domain-specific uses, a reviewer should confirm the precise sense used by each linked TOEIC headword before the entries are considered approved.

## Integrity boundary

No headword, stable ID, topic, synonym, antonym, word-family relationship, question, answer key or learner record was modified. The source ledger is `data/vocabulary/batch-021.json`; the safe patch is `patches-related-terms/v2.95.14/related-terms-001.json`.

This 80-question bank is separate from Reading Part 5 and must not be counted as Mock-eligible. Check the complete sentence, grammar focus, distractors, translation and every option explanation.

### `p5-sc-001` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The HR manager asked all new employees to __________ the orientation form by Friday.
- Choices: **A. complete**<br>B. completion<br>C. completely<br>D. completed
- Current keyed answer: **A. complete**
- Grammar point: Verb pattern: ask + object + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: “to” đứng ngay trước chỗ trống nên chỉ động từ nguyên mẫu “complete” phù hợp; các lựa chọn còn lại là danh từ, trạng từ hoặc quá khứ phân từ.
- Vietnamese translation: Quản lý nhân sự yêu cầu tất cả nhân viên mới hoàn thành biểu mẫu định hướng trước thứ Sáu.

- Vietnamese translation: Vui lòng chuyển tiếp hợp đồng đã ký đến bộ phận pháp chế để xem xét.
- Reviewer: [ ] grammar correct  [ ] sentence natural  [ ] distractors wrong  [ ] translation/explanations accurate  [ ] one defensible answer
- Decision: `________` · Correction / notes: __________________________________________

### `p5-sc-076` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The company plans to __________ its response time by introducing an online support desk.
- Choices: A. improvement<br>B. improved<br>C. improving<br>**D. improve**
- Current keyed answer: **D. improve**
- Grammar point: Plan + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: Chỉ “improve” tạo đúng mẫu “plans to + base verb”.
- Vietnamese translation: Công ty dự định cải thiện thời gian phản hồi bằng cách triển khai quầy hỗ trợ trực tuyến.
- Reviewer: [ ] grammar correct  [ ] sentence natural  [ ] distractors wrong  [ ] translation/explanations accurate  [ ] one defensible answer
- Decision: `________` · Correction / notes: __________________________________________

### `p5-sc-077` · Gerunds and Infinitives

- Sentence: The facilities team spends two hours each morning __________ the public areas.
- Choices: A. maintain<br>**B. maintaining**<br>C. maintenance<br>D. maintained
- Current keyed answer: **B. maintaining**
- Grammar point: Spend time + gerund
- Single-answer rationale: Chỉ “maintaining” hoàn thành cấu trúc “spends two hours ...”; danh từ hoặc nguyên mẫu không phù hợp.
- Vietnamese translation: Nhóm cơ sở vật chất dành hai giờ mỗi sáng để bảo trì các khu vực công cộng.

### `p5-sc-078` · Prepositions and Collocations

- Sentence: The project team managed to accomplish its goals __________ the original deadline.
- Choices: A. among<br>B. beyond<br>**C. within**<br>D. beside
- Current keyed answer: **C. within**
- Grammar point: Within + time limit/deadline
- Single-answer rationale: “Within” là giới từ duy nhất diễn tả hoàn thành trong giới hạn thời gian; “beyond” mang nghĩa ngược lại.
- Vietnamese translation: Nhóm dự án đã hoàn thành các mục tiêu trong thời hạn ban đầu.

### `p5-sc-079` · Prepositions and Collocations

- Sentence: New employees must adapt __________ the company’s safety procedures before starting work.
- Choices: A. with<br>**B. to**<br>C. for<br>D. at
- Current keyed answer: **B. to**
- Grammar point: Adapt to + noun
- Single-answer rationale: “Adapt to the company’s safety procedures” là kết hợp chuẩn; các giới từ còn lại không mang nghĩa thích nghi với quy trình.
- Vietnamese translation: Nhân viên mới phải thích nghi với các quy trình an toàn của công ty trước khi bắt đầu làm việc.

### `p5-sc-080` · Adjectives and Adverbs

- Sentence: Payroll is processed __________, on the last working day of each month.
- Choices: A. month<br>**B. monthly**<br>C. monthly basis<br>D. month’s

# Vocabulary Sense Expansion — v2.95.12

## Scope and baseline

- Baseline source: v2.95.11.
- Candidate: v2.95.12.
- Canonical inventory remains 1,141 headwords across A–Z.
- No new canonical headword was added.
- No `id`, `word` or `topics` field was changed. The patch identity guards capture the prior identity/topic values for the affected records.
- All additions/corrections are provisional and **pending independent lexical review**. Dictionary references are source evidence, not a claim of second-person editorial approval.

## Nine existing headwords with separated meanings

| Headword | Meaning distinctions introduced | Added examples |
|---|---|---:|
| `address` | noun: contact/mail location; verb: deal with a matter or problem | 1 |
| `application` | noun: formal written request; noun: software application | 1 |
| `claim` | noun: request for compensation/benefit; verb: assert that something is true | 1 |
| `draft` | noun: preliminary document version; verb: write the first version | 1 |
| `issue` | noun: problem or matter; verb: formally issue/provide a document | 1 |
| `order` | noun: purchase order; verb: request goods/services; noun: official instruction | 1 |
| `record` | noun: stored written information; verb: store information for later use | 1 |
| `position` | noun: job/rank; noun: situation or standing | 1 |
| `term` | noun: contract condition; noun: fixed period/tenure; noun: school semester | 2 |

The project-wide multi-sense count increased from 30 to 39. Dedicated examples associated with multi-sense records increased from 61 to 81. Each added example has a `sense_index` pointing to its intended sense.

## Precision and cross-link corrections

- `order`'s goods-order noun sense now uses `purchase order` rather than `purchase request`. Cambridge describes a purchase order as a document requesting goods or services from a supplier and setting out transaction details. Source: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/purchase-order
- `claimant` now links back to the `n` sense of `claim`, with the noun-specific Vietnamese gloss. This avoids the former ambiguous `n/v` family link after `claim` was split into separate noun and verb senses.
- 22 supporting terms received Vietnamese glosses and Cambridge source URLs in `data/related-terms.json` so newly referenced synonyms/antonyms are not presented without a gloss.

## Data patch trail

1. `patches/v2.95.12/batch-001.json` — 18 operations across the nine target headwords; allowed paths `/senses` and `/examples` only.
2. `patches/v2.95.12/batch-002-family-link.json` — claimant reverse family link narrowed to `claim` noun.
3. `patches/v2.95.12/batch-003-family-gloss.json` — reverse link gloss aligned with the full noun-sense gloss.
4. `patches/v2.95.12/batch-004-order-synonym.json` — `purchase request` corrected to `purchase order`.
5. `patches-related-terms/v2.95.12/related-terms-001.json` — 22 sourced glossary additions using `tools/patch-related-terms.py` with a base-file SHA-256 precondition.

Each vocabulary patch has `expect.old`, a stable ID-set hash, a narrow `allowedPaths` list, and dry-run/apply records. The related-term patch accepts only absent terms with HTTPS Cambridge Dictionary source URLs; rollback removes only the exact entries introduced by that patch.

## Measured changes

| Measure | v2.95.11 baseline | v2.95.12 candidate |
|---|---:|---:|
| Canonical headwords | 1,141 | 1,141 |
| Stable ID set | 1,141 | 1,141; 0 added / 0 missing |
| Multi-sense headwords | 30 | 39 |
| Examples associated with multi-sense records | 61 | 81 |
| Related-term glossary entries | 347 | 369 |
| Unmatched synonym/antonym occurrences (exact-term comparison) | 546 | 528 |

The 546 → 528 comparison counts synonym/antonym occurrences across canonical senses whose case-folded term is absent from `related-terms.json`. It is a custom comparison script, not a separate validator field; the built-in validator reports its own distinct `333/817` summary after the change. Do not conflate the two measures.

## Sources

- Cambridge Dictionary — address: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/address
- Cambridge Dictionary — application: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/application
- Cambridge Dictionary — application software: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/application-software

# Foundation A2 Assessment Quality Pass — v2.95.43

## Scope
- 13 core A2 Reading resources + 13 core A2 Listening resources; the new 13 supplementary A2 Listening clips (39 questions) are separately scoped and pending independent review.
- Focused review of within-resource q2/q3 repetition, answer-key uniqueness, four-choice integrity and explicit source traceability for changed/retained focus questions.
- Five question prompts/answer tasks were materially revised; six reviewed question records now carry exact source-evidence pointers.

## Automated integrity results
| Bank | A2 resources | A2 questions | A2 answer positions A/B/C/D |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Reading | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |
| Listening | 13 | 39 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 |

- All A2 questions require four unique choices, a valid answer index, a non-empty prompt and rationale.
- Each A2 resource must have three questions with non-identical q2/q3 correct answers.
- Each source-evidence pointer is checked as an exact substring of its Reading passage or spoken Listening segment.
- Core Reading answer positions remain A/B/C/D = 15/15/15/14; Listening full bank including supplementary practice is A/B/C/D = 25/25/24/24.
- Existing A2 q1/q2 objects remain protected by the v2.75.0 canonical-hash baseline tests.

## Focused changes
| Question | Change |
|---|---|
| `a2-quantities::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with a consequence/inference question about the delivery timing and preparation of training materials. |
| `a2-comparisons::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with an inference about the customer's priority: dependable, on-time delivery versus lowest price. |
| `a2-obligation-permission::reading1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the separate departure requirement to return the visitor badge. |
| `a2-comparisons::listening1::q3` | Reworded q3 to test the stated reliability/on-time advantage; q2 remains byte-identical to the v2.75.0 baseline. |
| `a2-sequencing-instructions::listening1::q3` | Replaced q3 with the immediately preceding action before preparing the return label. |

## Review boundary
- The pass fixes five identified cases of repeated information and records six exact source pointers. It does not certify every distractor for semantic plausibility or uniqueness.
- The work is an internal single-author review. Independent second-person language review and psychometric validation remain pending.
- The local A2 three-question / 67% rule is a practice threshold only; it is not a CEFR standard, mastery declaration or ETS equivalence.

## Automated audit status
- **PASS** — all registered structural, source-evidence, pair-distinction and answer-position checks passed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.95.18

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **502** (239 Listening + 263 Reading).

## Quality / verification status

- Content counts do not equal completed learning outcomes.
- Outcome framework: 33/33 criteria defined; 6/33 have an evidence-collection path. Neither count measures learner mastery.
- TOEIC objective tracker: aggregates latest answer per stable unique question; minimum 10 unique items and 80% accuracy. A passing label is a practice threshold only, not CEFR/ETS certification or proof of every outcome.
- Objective evidence is connected for Grammar, Listening Parts 1–4, Reading Parts 5–7 and separate Part 5 practice. Reserve Listening items are excluded until editorial review; Reading Part 7 remains second-review-gated; the separate 80-item Part 5 practice pool is review-pending and cannot earn a threshold status.
- Listening Part 1 currently has 8 eligible unique questions (one additional mapped item is reserve-pending), below the 10-item minimum; at least 2 more unique, reviewed questions are needed before it can reach the practice threshold.
- Foundation outcome evidence now records recognition, a learner-authored sentence with three self-report explanation/production ratings, and delayed recall. Self-report is not auto-graded; delayed recall is scheduled 1/3 days and is not a retention guarantee.
- Foundation Listening stores attempts under a separate localStorage key; its bank coverage does not imply the learner has completed the questions or met the local practice threshold.
- Supplementary A2 Listening has 13 six-turn dialogues (75–100 words each), 39 questions across detail, purpose/context and inference/next-action, with exact source-evidence snippets; all remain pending independent review and use browser TTS.
- v2.92.0 batch 024 adds 8 Grammar lessons / 24 exercises, 6 TOEIC Listening units / 18 questions, and 6 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 27 questions. All 12 new Listening/Reading resources remain reserve-pending-independent-review and excluded from Mock eligibility. v2.93.0 batch 025 adds 9 Grammar lessons / 27 exercises, 8 TOEIC Listening units / 20 questions, 8 TOEIC Reading Part 7 resources / 36 questions and 4 vocabulary headwords; new Listening/Reading items remain pending independent review and Mock-excluded.
- Foundation A–Z records TTS play-button actions in `toeic:alphabet-sound-progress:v1`; no pronunciation analysis or mastery inference is performed.
- Part 5 practice: pending independent review; do not count as Mock-eligible.
- Independent-review handoff queue: 193 Listening questions across 89 units + 87 Reading Part 7 questions across 22 resources + 80 separate Part 5 questions = 360 item-level decisions. Queue presence means traceable reviewer handoff only, not approval or Mock eligibility.
- Listening pending-review pool and Mock-eligible counts must be tracked separately from raw inventory.
- Placement is a short sample, not official CEFR/ETS certification.
- TOEIC score readiness is a local evidence tracker based on three completed 200-question Full Mocks; it shows L/R practice-accuracy trends only and does not convert raw accuracy into ETS scaled scores or claim 500+/850+ readiness.
- Remote CI, GitHub Pages deployment and physical-device QA are not inferred from local checks.

## Reporting rule

A percentage is shown only when a defensible target or denominator exists. Otherwise the report says “Chưa đo được” and records the current inventory without inventing a target.

## Reviewer record

- Reviewer name / role: ____________________________________
- Review date: _____________________________________________
- Review method / reference material: ________________________
- Decision key: `APPROVE` / `REVISE` / `REJECT` (record per item; do not approve a whole batch by default).
- For approval: confirm one defensible key, all distractors are wrong in context, source evidence supports the key, and explanation/translation are accurate.
- For revision: record the exact field and proposed correction; keep the item out of Mock until the correction is retested.

## A. Listening reserve

For Part 2, assess speech act, polarity, indirect response and naturalness. For Parts 3–4, assess transcript support and distractor plausibility. For Part 1, inspect the photo itself as well as the spoken statements.

### `p5-sc-001` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The HR manager asked all new employees to __________ the orientation form by Friday.
- Choices: **A. complete**<br>B. completion<br>C. completely<br>D. completed
- Current keyed answer: **A. complete**
- Grammar point: Verb pattern: ask + object + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: “to” đứng ngay trước chỗ trống nên chỉ động từ nguyên mẫu “complete” phù hợp; các lựa chọn còn lại là danh từ, trạng từ hoặc quá khứ phân từ.
- Vietnamese translation: Quản lý nhân sự yêu cầu tất cả nhân viên mới hoàn thành biểu mẫu định hướng trước thứ Sáu.

- Single-answer rationale: Sau “to” của cụm “be designed to” cần động từ nguyên mẫu “encourage”.
- Vietnamese translation: Chương trình ghi nhận mới được thiết kế nhằm khuyến khích nhân viên chia sẻ các ý tưởng thiết thực.

### `p5-sc-074` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: Managers must __________ that all visitors sign in at reception.
- Choices: A. ensuring<br>B. ensures<br>C. ensured<br>**D. ensure**
- Current keyed answer: **D. ensure**
- Grammar point: Modal verb + base form
- Single-answer rationale: “Ensure” là dạng nguyên mẫu duy nhất đi sau “must”; các lựa chọn khác sai dạng động từ.
- Vietnamese translation: Các quản lý phải bảo đảm tất cả khách đến thăm đăng ký tại quầy lễ tân.

- Sentence: Please forward the signed contract __________ the legal department for review.
- Choices: **A. to**<br>B. at<br>C. for<br>D. with
- Current keyed answer: **A. to**
- Grammar point: Forward something to a recipient
- Single-answer rationale: “To the legal department” xác định đích đến của tài liệu; các giới từ còn lại không thể hiện quan hệ chuyển tiếp này.
- Vietnamese translation: Vui lòng chuyển tiếp hợp đồng đã ký đến bộ phận pháp chế để xem xét.

### `p5-sc-076` · Infinitives and Verb Patterns

- Sentence: The company plans to __________ its response time by introducing an online support desk.
- Choices: A. improvement<br>B. improved<br>C. improving<br>**D. improve**
- Current keyed answer: **D. improve**
- Grammar point: Plan + to-infinitive
- Single-answer rationale: Chỉ “improve” tạo đúng mẫu “plans to + base verb”.
- Vietnamese translation: Công ty dự định cải thiện thời gian phản hồi bằng cách triển khai quầy hỗ trợ trực tuyến.

### `p5-sc-077` · Gerunds and Infinitives

- Sentence: The facilities team spends two hours each morning __________ the public areas.
- Choices: A. maintain<br>**B. maintaining**<br>C. maintenance<br>D. maintained
- Current keyed answer: **B. maintaining**
- Grammar point: Spend time + gerund
- Single-answer rationale: Chỉ “maintaining” hoàn thành cấu trúc “spends two hours ...”; danh từ hoặc nguyên mẫu không phù hợp.

- `tools/validate-learning-content.py` checks IDs, choices, answers, explanation presence, Part coverage, passages and image assets. It does not prove semantic correctness; editorial review remains required.
